notes.title: Big Update
notes.content:
Gameplay
A new mechanic was implemented “Opportunities”, improving the second ball plays and making the game more dynamic.
More freedom of movement for the players
Faster sets plays in hard mode
Levantamentos mais rápidos no modo hard
Some AI improvements

Animations
The animations were all redone from the scratch using new techniques
(Although they got only a little better)

Languages
Official French support has been added
Partial translation were added (tutorial e main menus) in these languages:
Simplified Chinese, Japanese, German, Turkish, Russian, Italian

Bugs fixed
AI ball distribution
Inverted celebrations when in the opponent’s errors
Bug where special codes were saved for multiple matches

Other small improvements
Camera moviment
Extras sounds
Graphical changes to some assets
Achievements were made easier
Scoreboard options for faster matches
Increased HUD size to play in smaller screens (but I have no idea if the game runs on steamdeck)

notes.title: Fix some bugs and a new player
notes.content:
New character to choose for your setter

Bugs
fixed the possibility of getting stuck in photo mode
fixed the problem of sets of the thirteenth team in hard mode
fixed libero entering the court to save the ball (as seventh player) 
removed a glitch that facilitated triple block
prevent system messages from appearing on the screen

Others things like small changes on gameplay, passwords and IAs
